title: Art Assembly Card
description: A recipe under data/art/_sets/<group>/<slug>/<stage>/ that combines an identity (heroArt), a stage template, and pieces into one generated prompt (output). Any extra string field is a literal one-off token for the template (the generator treats them that way), so extras are allowed but must be strings. Cross-file integrity (paths exist, outputs unique, link back to a card) is enforced by tools/validators/validate_data.py.

heroArt.description: Art identity file (which in turn links to the gameplay card)

figureProfile.description: standard = the hero's X Pose figure from _settings/phrases.json (cards fed the original photo); individual (default) = her own physique

keyDetails.description: Details called out up front in a Critical details block (and left out of the later lines); overrides the template default

finish.description: Marks this card as an art edition of its hero's card (key in finishes.json); the card must list it under art.variants

components.description: Named slots -> piece path, literal text, or '+literal' to extend a default
